# `silk/text/idna`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Convert international domain names with UTS #46 processing (Unicode 18.0.0), and encode and
decode Punycode (RFC 3492).

## When to use
Use [`Idna.toAscii`](#Idna.impl.toAscii) to turn a domain name that a person typed, such as `Bücher.example`, into
the ASCII form that DNS and URLs use (`xn--bcher-kva.example`). Use [`Idna.toUnicode`](#Idna.impl.toUnicode) to show
an ASCII domain name to a person. Use [`Punycode`](#Punycode) for the label encoding alone.

## Details
Processing is nontransitional: `ß`, `ς`, U+200C, and U+200D stay as they are. [`IdnaOptions`](#IdnaOptions)
selects the optional checks of UTS #46 section 4. The mapping table is from Unicode 18.0.0, and
normalization uses the NFC data of `silk.text.unicode`.

## Examples
### Convert a domain name to ASCII
```silk
import silk.mem.allocator { Allocator, OutOfMemoryError }
import silk.core.effect { Effect }
import silk.text.string { String }
import silk.text.idna { Idna, IdnaOptions }

pub effect fn main() -> i32
  ! OutOfMemoryError {
  let mut allocator = Allocator.systemAllocatorProvider()
  let mut output = String.make()
  let valid = run Idna.toAscii("Bücher.example", IdnaOptions.lenient(), &mut output)
    |> Effect.provideMut<Allocator>(&mut allocator)
  if !valid || String.view(&output) != "xn--bcher-kva.example" {
    return 1
  }
  return 0
}
```

Import as `Idna` with `import silk.text.idna { Idna }`.

## `IdnaOptions`

```silk
pub struct IdnaOptions
```

The optional checks of UTS #46 processing.

### Details
Each field turns on one check of UTS #46 section 4. A domain name that fails a check that is on
is not valid.

<a id="IdnaOptions.checkHyphens"></a>

### Field `checkHyphens`

```silk
pub checkHyphens: bool
```

Reject labels that start or end with `-`, or that have `--` in positions 3 and 4.

<a id="IdnaOptions.checkBidi"></a>

### Field `checkBidi`

```silk
pub checkBidi: bool
```

Apply the bidirectional rule of RFC 5893 to each label of a domain name that has
right-to-left characters.

<a id="IdnaOptions.checkJoiners"></a>

### Field `checkJoiners`

```silk
pub checkJoiners: bool
```

Apply the CONTEXTJ rules of RFC 5892 to U+200C and U+200D.

<a id="IdnaOptions.useStd3AsciiRules"></a>

### Field `useStd3AsciiRules`

```silk
pub useStd3AsciiRules: bool
```

Allow only `a`-`z`, `0`-`9`, and `-` as ASCII characters in a label.

<a id="IdnaOptions.verifyDnsLength"></a>

### Field `verifyDnsLength`

```silk
pub verifyDnsLength: bool
```

Reject empty labels, labels longer than 63 bytes, and names longer than 253 bytes.

<a id="Idna.impl.toAscii"></a>

### Associated function `toAscii`

```silk
pub effect fn toAscii(domain: string, options: IdnaOptions, output: &mut String) -> bool
    ! OutOfMemoryError
    ? &mut Allocator
```

Appends the ASCII form of `domain` to `output`, and returns whether `domain` is valid.

#### Details
It maps, normalizes, and checks `domain`, then encodes each label that has non-ASCII
characters as `xn--` and Punycode. The options select the optional checks. When the result is
`false`, `output` holds the converted text, which must not be used as a domain name.

#### Errors
- `OutOfMemoryError` if the `Allocator` fails.

<a id="Idna.impl.toUnicode"></a>

### Associated function `toUnicode`

```silk
pub effect fn toUnicode(domain: string, options: IdnaOptions, output: &mut String) -> bool
    ! OutOfMemoryError
    ? &mut Allocator
```

Appends the Unicode form of `domain` to `output`, and returns whether `domain` is valid.

#### Details
It maps, normalizes, and checks `domain`, and decodes each `xn--` label. A label that does not
decode stays as it is. The options select the optional checks. Even when the result is
`false`, `output` holds the converted text, as UTS #46 ToUnicode specifies.

#### Errors
- `OutOfMemoryError` if the `Allocator` fails.

<a id="Punycode.impl.decode"></a>

### Associated function `decode`

```silk
pub effect fn decode(text: &[u8], output: &mut List<u32>) -> bool
    ! OutOfMemoryError
    ? &mut Allocator
```

Decodes the Punycode `text`, without the `xn--` prefix, and appends the code points to
`output`. Returns `false` if `text` is not valid Punycode; `output` then holds a part of the
result.

#### Details
Letters can be uppercase or lowercase. A result that is not a Unicode scalar value is not
valid.

#### Errors
- `OutOfMemoryError` if the `Allocator` fails.

<a id="Punycode.impl.encode"></a>

### Associated function `encode`

```silk
pub effect fn encode(points: &[u32], output: &mut String) -> ()
    ! OutOfMemoryError
    ? &mut Allocator
```

Encodes `points` as Punycode, without the `xn--` prefix, and appends it to `output`.

#### Details
Digits are lowercase letters and `0`-`9`. Each value must be a Unicode scalar value.

#### Errors
- `OutOfMemoryError` if the `Allocator` fails.
